title: CI in GitHub, deploy verified build to Amplify; reconcile develop
description: develop kept the retired S3/CloudFront workflow while main moved to Amplify on Sept 18; the content repo still builds and syncs every content push to the retired S3 bucket; Amplify still runs the full Gatsby build on every main push. Goal: GitHub Actions builds and verifies on PRs and pushes; on main, only after a green build, upload the verified public/ to Amplify (manual-deploy app) so Amplify spends no build minutes. Also: merge main into develop (Git Flow), restore /posts/ excerpt headlines, restore content-repo redirect pages that 404 in production.

comments.text: Done in branches: chore/merge-main-into-develop (merge; content pin and posts-list conflicts resolved; build plus both verification scripts green; /posts/ headlines are excerpts again) and feature/github-ci-amplify-deploy (ci.yml build/verify/deploy; setup-amplify-github-deploy.sh; AGENTS deployment section; post-build copy of content redirect pages, which 404 in production). actionlint clean; deploy shell simulated with stand-in aws/curl for SUCCEED and FAILED. Content repo: feature/content-ci-check-only replaces the S3 deploy with a build check against develop. Needs Ryan (no AWS access here): run the setup script, set repo variables, move the custom domain, delete the Git-connected app and the retired S3 bucket and distribution.
